saw_lines: Furniture buyers check size, fabric and delivery before they click, because a sofa or chair is hard to send back.
So the sale is won or lost on delivery, and that answer must appear in the ad itself, before anyone clicks.
Your 6 of 11 copy ads open on the same “plongez dans l’univers batiplus” line, so name 2 or 3 new angles from your own product and test them against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: 6 of your 11 copy ads open on the same “plongez dans l’univers batiplus” line, so most buyers see one story. Name 2 or 3 new angles from your own range, such as sofas and showrooms, and run each against it.
Your site explains how a piece arrives, yet 0 of 12 ads show it, so a buyer weighing a sofa has no answer before the click. Film one video ad of the box arriving and unpacking at the door.
One exact copy runs in 6 of your 11 copy ads, so the same buyer reads identical words. Keep that copy as the body, but change the opening line and visual in each of the six.
No proof number in the ads

None of your 12 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has no sign that other people chose Batiplus before them. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and open two ads with it.

ads_1: New openers from your sofa and showroom range, tested against the current Batiplus story
